metadata.dcterms:title: Glasgow Mathematical Journal (2026), 1–10
metadata.dcterms:creator: ARTICLE, RESEARCH
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give a simple construction of Markov traces for Iwahori–Hecke algebras associated with the crystallographic Coxeter groups of types An, Bn and Dn. In types B and D, it is new and generalises a known construction in type A employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys–Murphy elements.
